summary: Tested live homepage, responsive navigation, assessment modal, validation, state retention, successful lead submission, FAQ accordion, and lead API persistence.

integration_issues.issue: Assessment catches any POST /api/leads failure and still shows success, so users can be told their lead was received when it was not persisted.

action_items: Only show assessment success after /api/leads returns successfully; expose a retry/error state on failure.
Validate required budget (and other required step-1/step-2 fields) before allowing Continue, or explicitly make them optional.
critical_code_review_comments: LeadCreate validates field presence but not email, phone, or consent semantics server-side; browser validation alone is bypassable.
seed_data_creation: One TEST Orbitus API lead was created through the public API for persistence verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview tested at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Mobile width 390 had no horizontal overflow; mobile menu, modal, full assessment, FAQ open/close passed. API valid POST returned 200 with id and persisted response. Initial pytest attempt failed due test fixture newline parsing, then passed after trimming env value; this is not an app defect.
rca of the issue: Assessment.submit wraps axios.post in catch (_) with no state change and unconditionally calls setSent(true). Any backend, network, or database failure therefore produces a false-positive success state. Assessment.next only checks qualification on step 1 and english on step 2; budget can remain empty and still progress.
